title: Detective Mummy Dragon
desc: When the mummy dragon embarks on a killing spree, terrorising everyone, the empress appoints Dee Renji to tackle the problem.

title: Manikarnika
desc: After the death of her husband and child, Lakshmibai takes over the throne of Jhansi and defends the kingdom against the tyranny of the East India Company.

title: Venky Mama
desc: Venkatarathnam raises Karthik, his orphaned nephew, on his own after the death of his parents. Things change when Karthik suddenly leaves home without notice.

title: Vaishnavi
desc: Born with the divine power, Vaishnavi receives treatment as a goddess by the villagers. After getting killed, she possesses the body of another girl who looks like her to exact revenge for her death.

title: Snake Cave
desc: Shipwrecked survivors reach a mysterious island, only to discover it is home to enormous snakes and ancient creatures, forcing them into a desperate fight for survival.

title: Pralay the Destroyer
desc: Some thugs annihilate an entire family and flee the scene without facing any consequences. Years later, the universe balances the scales of justice through the sole survivor of the tragedy.
